title: Two commands joined by a pipe
summary: Two children, one pipe, dup2 on each side: printf | sort.
hints: Create the pipe first. Child 1: `dup2(p[1], 1)`, close both pipe ends, `execlp("printf", ...)`. Child 2: `dup2(p[0], 0)`, close both, `execlp("sort", ...)`.
The PARENT must close both ends too, then wait for both children: `sort` only finishes when every copy of the write end is closed.
